name: WebnLive AI Assistant
author: ATIK

sections.description:
Overview
WebnLive AI Assistant is a free WordPress plugin that helps you generate high-quality, SEO-friendly AI content quickly and easily. Generate blog posts, reviews, guides, FAQs, tutorials, and more with multiple AI models.

Core Features:
– Generate high-quality, SEO-friendly unique content with AI.
– Supports multiple AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter).
– Customizable content structure and writing styles.
– Multi-language support.
– Simple and user-friendly interface.
– Works seamlessly with the WordPress editor.

Features

  • AI-powered content generation.
  • Customizable content types: Blog posts, reviews, guides, FAQs, tutorials, etc.
  • Supports multiple languages.
  • Title suggestion and modification for posts/pages.
  • Live writing system for seamless content creation.
  • Works with custom post types.

External Services

This plugin connects to several third-party AI services to generate content based on user input.

  1. OpenAI API

    • Used for AI content generation and chat completions.
    • Sends the user’s prompt text to OpenAI servers each time content is generated.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  2. Gemini API

    • Used to generate content with Google’s Gemini AI models.
    • Sends the user’s prompt text to Gemini servers when content generation is requested.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  3. OpenRouter API

    • Provides an alternative AI content generation service.
    • Sends the user’s prompt text to OpenRouter servers during content creation.
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

When using this plugin, the user’s input text (prompt) is transmitted to these third-party services to generate the requested content. The data is securely handled and only used for content generation purposes. This disclosure ensures transparency and legal compliance regarding external data transmissions.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the webnlive-ai-assistant folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the API settings from the ‘WebnLive AI Assistant’ settings page in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Start generating content instantly!
sections.faq:
What AI models does this plugin support?

The plugin currently supports OpenAI, Gemini, and OpenRouter models for content generation.

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes, you can adjust the style, and content structure before publishing the generated content.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, WebnLive AI Assistant supports multiple languages for content generation.
